project.name: Aqua Meridian Waterpark
project.purpose: Large-scale Bedrock waterpark and mobile import test

notes: The material library is open-ended. The shared role palette is a baseline, not a maximum.
Named attractions must be synthesized from generic spatial and path primitives, not from hardcoded attraction enums.
Every requested feature must have hash-bound generated and independently evaluated evidence.
Room-to-door geometry remains explicitly unevaluated by schema v2; every other physical-review warning is a generation failure.

builds.name: Aqua Meridian 01 Arrival
features: Grand modern waterpark entrance with a resort sign and broad arrival plaza
Ticket windows, turnstiles, security screening, guest services and first-aid station
Glass-roofed atrium with a park map, clocks, directional signs, speakers and integrated lighting
Locker rooms, changing rooms, showers, restrooms and family facilities
Main promenade exits aligned south into the thrill and family sectors
Fine details including drains, benches, bins, planters, railings, counters and ventilation

builds.name: Aqua Meridian 02 Thrill Sector
features: Fifty-block-high sculptural slide tower with an elevator core and realistic access stairs
Four distinct open and enclosed flume routes with drops, turns, supports and runout channels
Queue switchbacks, loading-platform gates, guardrails, shade roofs and height-restriction signs
Deep splashdown pool, landing channels, lifeguard posts and rescue equipment
Pump and filtration facade with exposed pipes, vents, service doors and maintenance access
Connection plaza aligned east and north with adjacent waterpark sectors
Fine details including deck drains, coping, grates, cameras, speakers, lights and warning markings

builds.name: Aqua Meridian 03 Wave And Activity
features: Large wave pool with graduated beach entry and a deep-end wave-machine wall
Activity pool with lane markings, climbing wall, basketball goals and diving edge
Surf simulator with equipment counter, queue area, spectator deck and safety railings
Lifeguard stands, warning signs, depth markers, rescue rings and lane ropes
Broad pool deck with loungers, umbrellas, shade sails, showers and foot-rinse stations
Connection promenade aligned west, north and south
Fine details including pool coping, drains, expansion joints, lighting, planters, bins and speakers

builds.name: Aqua Meridian 04 Family River
features: Wide looping lazy river with bridges, entry stairs, current jets and tube-staging areas
Multi-level family play fortress with tipping bucket, spray features and small slides
Zero-depth splash pad with colorful safety surfacing and shaded parent seating
Rockwork islands, waterfalls, palms, ornamental planting beds and retaining walls
Accessible ramps, wide gates, step-free approaches and clearly marked emergency exits
Connection promenade aligned north and east
Fine details including railings, grates, drains, signs, clocks, lighting, benches and bins

builds.name: Aqua Meridian 05 Hospitality Service
features: Modern food hall with service counters, kitchens, dining seating and a glass facade
Two snack kiosks, vending alcove, towel station and retail counter
Private cabanas, pergolas, loungers, umbrellas and landscaped dining terraces
Back-of-house pump rooms, filtration plant, staff corridor and chemical-storage facade
Maintenance yard with screened service access, loading area, exposed pipes and vents
Connection promenade aligned north and west with a clearly marked emergency exit
Fine details including tables, counters, bins, recycling stations, lighting, signage, cameras and speakers
